reasoning: Upper bound: at any vertex v of K6, at least three of its five incident edges share a color. For endpoints x,y,z, either one internal edge has that color, giving a monochromatic triangle with v, or all three internal edges have the other color, giving triangle xyz. Lower bound: on vertices indexed modulo 5, color cycle edges (differences ±1) red and diagonals (differences ±2) blue. Each color class is a 5-cycle, hence triangle-free.
